title: Coaching
intro: Tranquil Haven Coaching offers confidential, psychologically-informed coaching for women navigating emotional overwhelm, relationship challenges, life transitions, and personal growth.
supportive: Healthcare professionals navigating stress, burnout, compassion fatigue, and career transitions
Inclusivity of diverse relationship dynamics and identity experiences across gender, sexuality, and culture
Reconnecting with personal identity and balance
packagesIntro: Choose what fits where you are right now — a single session for a current question, or a longer arc when something needs steady time.

packages.name: Clarity Session
packages.tagline: For gaining clarity on what's happening in your current situation and identifying your next step.
packages.description: Focus on your current challenge, untangling confusion, and identifying what actually matters right now so the situation becomes easier to understand and next steps feel clearer.

packages.name: Focused Support Package
packages.tagline: For working through a specific life or relationship situation with consistency and support.
packages.description: Designed for clients who want more than one conversation — movement rather than one-time insight. Exploration of what's going on, what patterns are repeating, and how different responses can begin to show up in daily life.

packages.name: Deeper Work Package
packages.tagline: For emotional patterns, relationship dynamics, and internal blocks that don't shift in one conversation.
packages.description: A slower process focused on understanding what keeps repeating so change can begin in a grounded, realistic way over time.

packages.name: Life Transition Package
packages.tagline: For longer-term support through a meaningful life change or emotional transition.
packages.description: Steady support during periods of change, with space for reflection, grounding, and rebuilding internal clarity and self-trust while moving through transition.

notice: Coaching is not psychotherapy, counseling, or mental health treatment. Tranquil Haven Coaching does not diagnose or treat mental health conditions.
